status: C02 G0 proposal for C01/C03 review; CONTRACT SHA NOT FROZEN

commands.browser_environment: CHROMIUM_PATH selects an installed Chrome/Chromium; PYTHONUTF8=1 on Windows
commands.generation: Explicit frozen engine SHA is required; existing goldens cannot be overwritten by the runner

canonicalization.name: tagged-binary64-utf16-v1
canonicalization.hash: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(tagged tree), no trailing newline
canonicalization.object: [object, [[key, tagged value], ...]]; keys sorted by JavaScript UTF-16 ordinal comparison
canonicalization.array: [array, [tagged element, ...]]; original order retained; absent indices use [hole]
canonicalization.number: [number, 16 lowercase hex digits of IEEE-754 binary64 big-endian bits]; finite values only; -0 differs from +0
canonicalization.presence: An absent object key, present undefined, and present null differ. JSON-save digest separately records what E.dump actually persists.
canonicalization.no_rounding: No tolerances, decimal rounding, array sorting, ID renumbering, field dropping or RNG re-seeding
canonicalization.domain: Live reference state and explicit observer witness; JSON candidate parsing needs strict duplicate-key/nonfinite validation before a future C# comparison

per_operation.before_after: Full authoritative-state digest, parsed-save digest, both observer digests, side/round/serial/CP/RNG/living counts
per_operation.result: Exact returned reference result, including error text; C03 must propose any structured-error mapping rather than silently discarding it
per_operation.event: Exact lastEvent after the operation. Invalid actions can clear a prior lastEvent; no blanket rejection-is-no-op assumption.
per_operation.ordering: All state arrays, legal-order arrays, units, ghosts, logs, choices and events retain reference iteration order

observer_witness.limits: Narrow source-backed witness, not an accepted production observation DTO. No unseen enemy fields or raw facility truth is included.
observer_witness.legality: orders() supplies geometry/knowledge independently from CP/activation. canAct and cost are recorded separately.
observer_witness.truth: Full hidden state remains a separate oracle digest; presentation must never receive it
